name: categorylinks_multisort
comment: Per-collation sort keys for category members, maintained by the CategoryMultisortNeue extension. Rows are keyed on (cms_from, cms_target_id) exactly like the categorylinks row they mirror, so no page or linktarget identity is duplicated here.

columns.name: cms_from
columns.comment: page_id of the member page; mirrors categorylinks.cl_from

columns.name: cms_target_id
columns.comment: linktarget.lt_id of the category; mirrors categorylinks.cl_target_id

columns.name: cms_mode
columns.comment: Sort mode identifier, a key of $wgCategoryMultisortNeueModes

columns.name: cms_variant
columns.comment: Language variant this key was built for. The wiki's mixed/un-converted variant ('zh') when variant-specific keys are disabled. A reader is served the key for their own variant, falling back to the default variant.

columns.name: cms_sortkey
columns.comment: Binary sort key produced by the mode's collation. Truncated to 230 bytes, the same limit maintenance/updateCollation.php applies.

indexes.name: cms_target_mode_sortkey
indexes.comment: Serves the category page query: WHERE cms_target_id = ? AND cms_mode = ? AND cms_variant = ? ORDER BY cms_sortkey
